DESCRIPTION:
Key Clinical Research Services Provided by PPD:

  • Early Development: Specialized services focusing on the initial phases of drug development to ensure seamless progression into clinical trials.​
  • Phase II-IV Clinical Trial Management: Expertise in managing clinical trials from proof-of-concept through post-marketing surveillance, including:​
  • Biostatistics​
  • Clinical Data Management​
  • Clinical Trial Monitoring​
  • Project Management​
  • Global Clinical Supplies​
  • Medical Writing​
  • Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics​
  • Pharmacovigilance​
  • Peri- and Post-Approval Services: Support for products nearing or having achieved regulatory approval, including real-world evidence generation and ongoing safety monitoring.​
  • Functional Service Partnerships: Customized solutions offering functional outsourcing in areas such as clinical operations, data management, and regulatory affairs.​
  • Laboratory Services: Comprehensive laboratory support encompassing:
  • Bioanalytical Lab Services
  • Biomarker Capabilities
  • Central Lab Services​
  • Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Lab Services​
  • Vaccine Sciences Lab Services​
  • Patient and Investigator Recruitment: Innovative strategies to enhance patient enrollment and site activation, ensuring timely and efficient trial execution.​
  • Regulatory Affairs: Expert guidance through the regulatory landscape to facilitate successful product approvals and market entry.​

PPD's extensive therapeutic expertise spans over 20 areas, including:​

  • Cell and Gene Therapy​
  • Critical Care​
  • Gastroenterology​
  • Dermatology​
  • Infectious Diseases​
  • Nephrology and Renal Diseases​
  • Oncology and Hematology​
  • Pediatrics
  • Respiratory​

This breadth of services and expertise positions PPD to effectively support clients in bringing life-changing therapies to market

DESCRIPTION:
Reduce your risk. Independent Informatics Project Management designed specifically for deployments into Life Sciences R&D.

*Experience*

OVER 100 DEPLOYMENTS
Why take the risk? We have experience deploying 100+ Enterprise systems across 6 continents and 25 countries, across all types of Life Sciences businesses. We know how to get it right.

*Availability*

HAVE YOU GOT TIME?
Internally run projects often fail as project managers have insufficient time due to additional responsibilities. We can ensure your project always receives the correct amount of attention

*Focus*

NO DISTRACTIONS
We don’t have to manage the typical daily distractions that our customers face, so we can focus solely on achieving the project goals and ensuring the best possible outcome.

- Planning and estimation
- Business and project goal alignment
- Project resource structuring
- Risk planning & mitigation
- Commercial management
- Distributed and offshore teams
- Vendor and stakeholder management
- Measuring (and celebrating) success

We have worked with many of the top Pharmaceutical and Biotech companies and have delivered projects ranging from 1 week to 2 years. We are used to working across different time zones and cultures, with the ever changing requirements of the scientist and the demands of the QA departments.

Projects have included many different work streams including installation, configuration, migration, integration, upgrades, validation, support and training.

We can work with your own project process or use our own methodology.
